steps.text: 8:52 P.M. \ Cloudy
Lungmen Slums

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Tell us where the Rat King is and nobody has to die!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Wh- what?! What's a Rat King... I don't even know what that is!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: I dare you to say 'what' again...!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Hey, Mr. Capone said not to rough up civilians...

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Does this piece of shit look like a civilian to you? I bet you're Infected, ain't you, cazzo? You still wanna play dumb?!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: P- please! Don't hurt me! I really don't know anything!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Cat got your tongue?!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Ng... gah... glehh...

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: C'mon, forget about this one. It ain't worth it.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Checking our list, looks like the next lucky contestant is some poor finball hawker. Lives right around here.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Sounds like a waste of time.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Gah... aaagh! They broke... my arm... those sons of...

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: I have to... tell them...

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: That's him. Over there.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: ...Can I help you?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: (Hold up. Check the mug over there. I got a bad feeling about him.)

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: (Some Lungmen triad? Mr. Capone says they're a bunch of pushovers.)

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: I got a question for ya.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: We don't want any trouble, right? Just give us a clean answer and we'll be on our way.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...There's blood on your knuckles.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Oh, pardon me. I was cleaning out the trash earlier.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: But a couple of upright citizens like yourselves, you ain't trash, are you?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Is that a threat?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: You're a smart girl, you can figure it out.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Then I refuse to help you.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: ...refuse?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: I think that came out wrong, girly.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: It sounded like you said you were dumpster garbage eager to get beaten half to death in that alleyway over there?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Waai Fu, I'm pretty sure that scream I just heard was...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Was 'garbage,' the word you just used?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Because one must be thorough and prepared for all eventualities, I will ask one more question: is that how you refer to the people here?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: I don't got time to waste talkin' shit with you, start talk——

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Wh- what was that?!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: You better——

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Gah?!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Next.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You know what, the kind of scum you are, I'll take you all on at once.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Not once in recorded history has evil triumphed over justice, and you evildoers who indiscriminately prey on the weak are not even worth a mention.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: What is this?! How does she move like that?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Just shoot her alrea——

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...not so fast.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Gah! Hey! Let go of me!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You know what you remind me of? A rotten finfish three days after the freezer lost power.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...nothing. I shouldn't try to copy Waai Fu's battle banter. I'll take the direct approach.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: S- so strong! Agh! Y- you're gonna break my arm! Stop!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Drop your weapon. And get out of my sight.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Al- alright already! Just let me go!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...I should probably break a bone or two just to be safe. You've got a real dangerous weapon there, after all.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Aaagh! P- please stop!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Wh- what's the deal with these two? Nobody warned us about any targets around here!

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Just get the hell outta here first. We'll talk later.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: I don't care what crew you guys are with, next time ain't gonna go your way. Damned Lungmenites.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Come on, we're not triads. Why do they always have to judge a book by its cover...?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Forget it, there's people to save. Over there!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Oh, right.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Don't move! We're here to help!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Ah Fil?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You're fine. It's just a flesh wound. Sit still and I'll go get a doctor. I won't be long.

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: Ah Fil! Don't worry about me. You have to go find Uncle Tung!

steps.name: Slum Dweller
steps.text: That's where they're going next!
